description: AcrossLimits (AL) is a technology company that also offers specialist consultancy services, with its roots firmly derived from the innovation and ICT sectors. It works throughout Europe and is based in Malta. The company was established in June 2001 as a limited liability company and has been participating in EU funded projects ever since. Our technical expertise covers many sectors, from technology and innovation research projects to development, digitisation, elearning, eHealth and mobile applications amongst others. Since its inception, AL has been involved in over 80 EU-funded projects. As EU project partners we have built our experience as technical partners, designing and developing digital platforms and/or elearning platforms mostly in the areas of eHealth, eCommerce, eGovernment, etc, as well as being the dissemination leads for various projects. As consultants, we provide our clients with support to access opportunities in Europe, such as training, accessing funding, networking, and taking research results to the market. Since 2004 the company has also been operating a private training centre under the brand name TrainingMalta which is licensed under the Malta Further and Higher Education Agency. We specialise in the delivery of practical and experiential training in a variety of industries including maritime, robotics, education and health, and also focusing on entrepreneurial and soft skills development. Further information can be found on www.trainingmalta.com. Our training centre is ISO9001:2015 certified. Here we have experience delivering in-person, virtual, and blended training courses but due to COVID, we had to shift almost entirely to our online training platform, although in-person learning is now picking back up. AL is also actively involved in research and here focuses its efforts on the creation of innovative ICT solutions, we are experts in the configuration and programming of cross-platform systems, notably in the area of Green ICT. At the European level, we are very active in various research programs covering diverse areas of interest which include: eLearning, environmental monitoring, Green ICT, telecare, e-Government, digital culture and in the promotion of gender equality. AcrossLimits maintains strong links with the equality-based groups in Europe and beyond and assists in the creation and sustainability of representative bodies. The closest to home is the Federation of Women Entrepreneurs, which is fully supported by AcrossLimits as a charitable trust. Our training wing is a registered college and is also fully supported by AcrossLimits to deliver personal and social development for disadvantaged individuals and technical skills development those working in education. The number of paid staff in our core team is around 15 people, however, we have over 50 international experts of various industries in our network based all throughout Europe, ready to provide their expertise on a contract basis.

Snowcap's ambition is to revolutionize the estimation of water reserves stored as seasonal snow in the mountains. This critical information can be used to optimize hydro-power operations, assist with flood forecasting, estimate fresh water resources and to help plan water utilization from local to regional scales.
We utilize state-of-the-art Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) based methodology to capture the variability in snow depth at high spatial resolution, across vast mountain ranges with an unprecedented sub-weekly temporal revisit frequency. The satellite SAR-based snow depth estimates over mountains are further combined with snow model simulations and radiometer-based observations of snow water equivalent over non-mountainous regions to allow for daily water resources analysis from local to continental scales.

entityDescription:
ANT-X designs and builds custom drone solutions tailored to specific industrial applications.

Based on the experience gathered as a university laboratory in the research area of guidance, navigation and control of UAVs, ANT-X has the competences needed to carry out the entire process of design, prototyping, integration and flight testing of custom UAV platforms.

ANT-X is able to:

_Design drone solutions tailored to the specific application, based on the user’s requirements.
_Identify and integrate a suitable sensor payload to the user’s particular application.
_Cover the entire development process of the UAV, including design, integration and prototyping.
_Assist the user in operations, in particular providing assistance to guarantee compliance to regulations.

ANT-X can leverage the experience as a research laboratory in the field of aerospace guidance and control, and propose innovative configurations beyond classical coplanar multi-rotor UAVs. The ANT-X solutions employ state-of-the-art open-source software running onboard the drone, which allows for easy integration with payload and existing infrastructure.

Moreover, ANT-X provides laboratory solutions for research and education in flight robotics and UAV control.

ANT-X is a spin-off company of Politecnico di Milano university.
